visible_observation: The feature story 'The Cartography of Leaving' is set in a dark serif font on a dark teal background. The large orange SVG circle overlaps the right side of the title text, and the horizontal wavy lines run directly through the excerpt text, making the words difficult to read.
critique: The decorative SVG elements (the circle and the lines) are layered on top of the primary text content, creating a high-contrast clash that significantly increases cognitive load and breaks the reading flow. The visual noise competes with the message rather than supporting it.
revision: Move the orange circle SVG element to the right so it sits in the empty negative space of the card, away from the text. Alternatively, reduce the opacity of the horizontal wavy lines to 10-15% or move them to the background layer (z-index) so the text remains the dominant, legible element.
protected_strength: The strong visual hierarchy that clearly separates the dominant feature story from the secondary articles and the clean, grid-based layout of the bottom row.
